entries.name: ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN
entries.description: The store's Zendesk subdomain: store for store.zendesk.com. Every request goes to that address.
howToGet: Read it from the address bar of the store's Zendesk: the part before .zendesk.com.

entries.name: ZENDESK_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The unique identifier of the OAuth client a Zendesk admin made for KaratOS in Admin Center.
howToGet: A Zendesk admin opens Admin Center, Apps and integrations, APIs, OAuth Clients, and adds a client named KaratOS (a confidential client).

entries.name: ZENDESK_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The KaratOS OAuth client's secret, sent only to the store's Zendesk sign-in, with the refresh token, for a short-lived token. It also seals the rotated refresh token in the instance's database.
howToGet: Zendesk shows the secret once, when the OAuth client is saved. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: ZENDESK_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from a Zendesk admin authorizing the KaratOS client for only tickets:read and users:read. Refresh tokens are single-use: KaratOS keeps the newest, encrypted, in its database, and this one seeds it. Each lasts 90 days, so a sync at least that often keeps it alive.
howToGet: A Zendesk admin authorizes the KaratOS client through Zendesk's authorization code flow, asking for the scopes tickets:read and users:read and nothing else. Incremental exports need an admin's token.
Exchange the code at POST /oauth/tokens and put the answer's refresh token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
To revoke it, delete the token or the OAuth client in Admin Center.
